correctness.rationale: Every acyclic orientation of \(K_{a,b}\) corresponds to a canonical alternation of part-symbol runs. The AB/BA adjacent exchange has exact difference \(\Delta\varphi(i)-\Delta\varphi(j)\); discrete strict convexity strictly improves each surplus imbalance. All and only balanced AB/BA tile words with larger-side tail survive, and the switching operation is a Robin Hood indegree transfer, proving majorization and the universal optimum. For a given side-word the number of labelled orientations is \(m!(m+t)!\) divided by same-letter run factorials; summing weights \(2^{-c}\) gives \((3/2)^{m-1}(1/t!+1/(t+1)!)\). Exhaustive labelled-edge enumeration covered 104334 edge assignments and 13638 DAGs in 52 strictly-convex cost tests, without taking finite evidence as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Complete classification and labelled multiplicities for a natural fairness optimization on an infinite graph family of unbounded size and degree; one optimizer set simultaneously minimizes all strictly convex separable indegree energies, yielding the exact majorization-minimal degree multiset and a factorial count. This is a mathematically substantive tractable class within a broadly hard problem, more informative than textbook exchange arithmetic alone.
